errors.text: The hypothesis incorrectly identifies 900–980 °C, particularly 950 °C, as the optimal SPS window, whereas the target result places the optimum at 1000 °C.
It replaces the observed oxide barrier phases AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 with an unsupported Ti/V-rich BCC intermetallic network.
It predicts deterioration at 1000 °C, directly contradicting the measured maximum density, hardness, oxidation resistance, and corrosion resistance at that temperature.
The predicted density and hardness do not agree with the reported 96.7% relative density and 1235.5 HV.
The cited evidence concerns materially different alloy and composite systems and does not establish Ti2Fe or a V-rich barrier phase in Mg-Al-Ti-V-Fe-Co.
